ModMetaData.name: Gravship Roof Solar
ModMetaData.author: 9ranr11d
ModMetaData.description:
Roof-mounted solar panels for gravships and substructure bases.
- A 4x4 solar panel that sits on top of the roof, so it can be built over walls, furniture and workbenches without using floor space - Same cost, power (1700 W), hit points and research as the vanilla solar generator; output follows sunlight and is not reduced by the roof it sits on - Needs substructure and a roof under all 16 cells. If any roof cell is lost (drop pod, roof removed, collapse) or the substructure disappears, the panel is destroyed and leaves the usual wreckage - Safe through gravship takeoff and landing - Hidden by default so it never covers what is underneath. Shown with the power grid overlay, while placing or deconstructing, or always via the new "Show roof solar panels" toggle in the bottom-right play settings - While that toggle is off, panels can't be selected by clicking or dragging, so they never get in the way of things below (deconstruction still works) - Plants growing below (e.g. hydroponics) are not cleared when the panel is built - Removing the mod removes the panels. Because panels replace the conduits under them, re-lay conduits there afterwards or the grid will have gaps
Limits: - A panel straddling the edge of a gravship engine's range is not carried by the ship - If the roof under a blueprint is removed before it is finished, the panel is destroyed on completion - Like the vanilla solar generator, every cell of the panel transmits power: it joins the grid by touching a conduit, another panel or a generator. Conduits under a panel are removed when it is built (the panel takes their place), and it cannot be placed over batteries, generators or switches - It is not shielded from fire or explosions in the rooms below
